own_solution.law: Snell's law at the entry face: sin r = sin 40 deg / n; zigzag path length L/cos r independent of the number of reflections; speed in glass v = c/n; t = n L / (c cos r)
assumptions: rays enter at the centre of the end face; TIR holds at sides (side incidence 69.1 deg > critical 33.7 deg)
non-dispersive glass so group = phase speed c/n

defect_reasons.rendering_not_minimal: T97AD and TACC7 say 'a short length' where the other extension sentences say '1.3 m', so if they are meant as variants of the 1.3 m sentences they differ in the number.

notes: sin r = 0.642788/1.8 = 0.357104, cos r = 0.934065; t = 1.8*2/(3e8*0.934065) = 1.2847e-8 s. With 3.3 m total: 1.8*3.3/(2.802195e8) = 2.1198e-8 s. Diameter sets the number of reflections but the total path L/cos r is independent of it, so it cancels (C). TE2F0/TACC7 refer to an earlier run only, so the present rod is 2 m (treated as D). The extension sentences assume a seamless joint (same glass).
